description:
Integrate comprehensive haptic feedback patterns across the app: light taps for navigation, medium impacts for confirmations (adding to watchlist), heavy impacts for errors, and selection feedback for scrubbing through video. Make intensity user-configurable in settings.

**Rationale:** Haptic feedback provides tactile confirmation of actions without requiring visual attention, particularly valuable when multitasking or watching content. It creates a more premium, polished feel and improves accessibility for visually impaired users.
